title: Paranoid
studio_context: Regent Sound and Island Studios, London, 16-18 June 1970. The title song was written last, as a filler: 'We didn't have enough songs for the album, and Tony Iommi just played the guitar lick and that was it.'

drum_performances.name: Bill Ward
drum_performances.why_it_matters: War Pigs' hats under the stabs and its snare on the 'e' of 3, Paranoid's kick in eighths, Iron Man's never-the-same-twice verse and its double-time solo and outro, Fairies Wear Boots' shuffle on the ride's bell, and Rat Salad, his drum solo.

notable_moments.description: 'I had some disappointments, especially with the bass drum sound on Iron Man.'
Rat Salad, about two and a half minutes of the solo he stretched to fill the band's long European sets.
